candidates.claim: fw-01 enables SSH management from 192.168.30.0/24 (CORP) on the corp interface, but the management policy allows device management only from MGMT 10.10.99.0/24 and on fw-01 only on the mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the SSH management entry for 192.168.30.0/24 on the corp interface and keep SSH management limited to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The current fw-01 snapshot adds the global SSH management entry for 192.168.30.0 that is not present in the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this baseline deviation and revert it unless an approved change record covers the SSH access from 192.168.30.0.
